commands.name: guard
commands.description: Budget guard: session cost and plan window limits (budget-guard)
commands.output:
on, in block mode. It warns at 80% of a limit.

  session cost   $0.42, no limit           not guarded
  5-hour window  31% of 90%                ok
  7-day window   not reported by the plan  not guarded

Change it:
  /guard cost 5     dollar limit for this session (0 turns it off)
  /guard 5h 90      percent of the 5-hour plan window
  /guard 7d 95      percent of the 7-day plan window
  /guard warn       only say so, never refuse
  /guard block      refuse tool calls once a limit is passed
  /guard override   allow the next turn even if a figure is over
  /guard off        turn the guard off    (/guard on turns it back)
Settings are kept in the plugin settings (/config shows them).

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

/guard → on, in block mode. It warns at 80% of a limit.
